observation.title: ASHVEIL 사족 섭식 work 확장 검토

findings: Fixed-heading front/left/right/back are present on both proposed source sheets.
Stag neck and boar short neck/snout stay lowered over slow four-pose chewing/sipping cycles, without painted food/water props.
The rejected boar v1 remains preserved and is not referenced by the proposed manifest.
Contact anchors exclude the front central muzzle and profile leading muzzle; front stag hoof y275 stays stable across all4poses.
Final actual alpha composition has no opaque brown background or bright transparent-RGB fringe.
Existing base69files and all7base clips/rig values remain byte-identical.
limitations: Actual animal grazing/drinking/escape/defense policy linkage and resource conservation belong to the parent integration.
Current default renderer work1000ms still needs an explicit presentation cycle override.
Main-game action cancellation, occlusion, diagonal motion and animation-speed acceptance not run.
